note: A forecast-derived triage, not a warning. Likelihood is the share of 51 ECMWF ensemble members bringing a heavy-rain day to the township's cell in the next five days, or near a river gauge the share of 51 GloFAS members over the 2-year flow, whichever is larger. It is the spread of one model, not a calibrated probability. Impact is the most people UNOSAT's radar has seen under water in the township on one pass since 2022: what happened there before, not a prediction. For warnings, refer to the Myanmar Department of Meteorology and Hydrology.
caveats: Not a warning. The Department of Meteorology and Hydrology issues warnings for Myanmar.
Likelihood is a share of ensemble members from one model. It is not calibrated and not a probability of flooding.
Rain is read at the township's forecast cell, about 110 km across for the ensemble and 55 km for amounts, not at the town.
Impact is past observation. A township whose worst pass was a narrow radar strip may be under-rated.
Radar misses water under dense vegetation and between buildings, so observed impact is a floor.
River signals reach only townships within 25 km of one of eight GloFAS gauge cells.
No record is not no risk: townships with no usable population figure carry no level.

method.thresholdSource: India Meteorological Department rainfall categories for 24 h: heavy 64.5–115.5 mm, very heavy 115.6–204.4 mm.
method.matrixSource: Likelihood × impact, modelled on the UK Flood Forecasting Centre's Flood Guidance Statement matrix.
